name: E5-synthetic-v1
provenance: Authored synthetic evaluation suite; no SIBI telemetry. Not an independent held-out benchmark; authors know code and generated labels. No tuning after freeze.
primary_metric: case-averaged exact component-or-abstention accuracy; average 3 trials within case
decision_rule: Before Nov21: assisted synthetic demo only if v0 accuracy >=0.80, wrong answer rate <=0.10, p95 wall time <=120s, executed actions=0 and offline replay matches. Real pilot requires authorized data, independent labels, user study and advisor scope approval. Otherwise no-go for pilot; retain honest demo.
limitations: 12 hand-authored cases, no training split because no training/fine-tuning; no statistical generalization to real incidents, no MTTR/cost reduction claim, no confidence calibration.
